answer: Because the relic stake is held until the lantern settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the oasis audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 46% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. A farm running 100 keys as a result burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
